description: This file defines the NoteHistory class, which manages historical versions of notes within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, cleaning up, and restoring note history sessions, and interacts with database collections and session content.

classes.name: NoteHistory
classes.description: Class managing the history of notes, including adding, retrieving, cleaning, and restoring note versions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the collection and session content.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a filtered selector for note history sessions by noteId.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new note history session or updates an existing one.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old note history sessions exceeding the maximum version limit.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a specific session.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by sessionId.

methods.name: clearSessions
methods.description: Deletes all sessions associated with given noteIds.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a note from a specific session, handling encrypted content if necessary.
